Earnings yield of 6.7% exceeds the 10Y Treasury at 4.57% by 213bps. P/B of 1.592x is near the floor of its 1.5x–2.1x range. The market is paying materially less for Disney's operating earnings than a year ago, which appears to overstate the fundamental deterioration given stable operating margins. Pillar 3 (Near-term catalyst): Q2 FY2026 earnings beat ($1.57 vs $1.49 consensus) reported ~May 6, 2026, with Citi raising its PT to $145. These offsetting near-term factors limit the catalyst boost. Net: a solid franchise at a meaningful discount to its own history, with improving DTC economics and parks investment, but tempered by below-the-line earnings noise, rising macro headwinds, and regulatory uncertainty. Score of +0.3 reflects mild-to-moderate attractiveness.

Net: valuation appears overdone to the downside relative to observed earnings improvement, but balance-sheet leverage, rate sensitivity, and earnings durability uncertainty cap the score at mildly attractive rather than strongly attractive.
